Miscellanous resources

EPIC the movie playlist

I've made playlist of fan-made animatics for the EPIC musical by Jorge Rivera-Herrans, arranged in song order so that it can be viewed as if it was a continous movie.

Youtube

A similar concept in one video is this compilation by Danneymation
